She wears dark sunglasses and turns her face toward the camera with a wide, cheerful smile. The sunlight is bright and direct, casting soft shadows on the ground around her. (3) The scene shifts as she begins to walk away from the camera towards the distant entrance of the cathedral. She turns her head back to look directly into the lens, her hair flowing naturally in the breeze. Numerous pedestrians and tourists are visible walking in various directions across the wide plaza. (4) She stops walking, removes her sunglasses with her right hand, and looks at the camera while adjusting her hair with her left hand. She maintains an expressive and joyful facial expression. The camera captures her in a medium full shot, emphasizing her interaction with the surrounding architectural environment. (5) The woman continues to pose, turning to show her side profile while looking back at the camera with a playful smile. She puts her sunglasses back on and performs a stylish hair flip. The editing uses quick cuts that align with the rhythmic pulses of the background audio track.
